## Appearance

Diana Barry is a very pretty girl with rosy, crimson cheeks, black eyes, and dimples. Her hair consists of black curls, described as glossy, jet-black tresses. She closely resembles her mother in her striking dark features.

## Personality

Inheriting a merry disposition from her father, Diana is also known for her practical nature. She possesses notable skill in rowing a dory, enjoys a reputation for her excellent taste in dressing, and is adept at making splendid lettuce salad.

## History

Diana Barry formed an immediate, fast friendship with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) upon meeting her at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), solemnizing their bond with a garden oath. Their play was temporarily disrupted when Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) forbade Diana from seeing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) after an incident involving Anne's imaginative antics, leaving the girls to share a dramatic goodbye and secret notes until [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) nursed Diana's younger sister, [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), through a severe case of croup. Restored to her friend's side, Diana hosted a party where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) broke her ankle, and she later brought [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) the news that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) had tied for first place on the island in the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) exams. Together, Diana and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) helped establish the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), actively canvassing their neighbors for funds, attempting to prevent offensive fence advertisements, and enduring community mishaps such as a local hall being accidentally painted bright blue. During their strolls, Diana shared local lore, such as the poignant story behind Hester Gray's hidden garden, and helped host visiting guests like Mrs. Charlotte E. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md). On a walk to [West Grafton](../codex/places.md#east-grafton), the two girls lost their way and discovered [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), befriending its secluded resident, Miss Lavendar [Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). When [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later prepared to leave [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) for [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), Diana expressed her deep anxiety about their upcoming separation and sought reassurance about Anne's feelings for [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). Shortly before Miss Lavendar's wedding, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovered Diana's secret romance with [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), after which Diana visited [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to confide her engagement to her best friend.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P64](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0064), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P1](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P2](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P7](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0007), +689 more_

## Quotes

> "You hold your head with such an air. I suppose it’s your figure. I am just a dumpling. I’ve always been afraid of it, and now I know it is so. Well, I suppose I shall just have to resign myself to it."
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P13](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0013)

> "I don’t want to think of it, it makes me so miserable, and I do want to have a good time this evening. What are you going to recite, Anne? And are you nervous?"
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P24](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0024)

> "You’ll ruin your dress in that wet grain . . . ruin it. She doesn’t hear me! Well, she’ll never get that cow out by herself. I must go and help her, of course."
>
> — Diana Barry — [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P14](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0014)

> "Oh, I know where we are now. That is the little stone house where Miss Lavendar Lewis lives . . . Echo Lodge, she calls it, I think. I’ve often heard of it but I’ve never seen it before. Isn’t it a romantic spot?"
>
> — Diana Barry — [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028)

> "I shall never love anybody . . . any girl . . . half as well as I love you. And if I ever do marry and have a little girl of my own I’m going to name her Anne."
>
> — Diana Barry — [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P61](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0061)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--diana-barry.md)

[Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is Diana's dearest bosom friend. Their bond began when they swore a solemn oath of friendship in the garden at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), and despite a brief separation when Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) forbade them from playing together, they grew inseparable. Diana frequently shares creative games, picturesque walks, and deep confidences with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), remaining her constant confidante through school and personal milestones.

- Friend of — dearest friend and bosom friend  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation P0](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P35](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0035), +43 more</sub>

### [Jane](../character/jane.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--jane.md)

[Jane](../character/jane.md) is a close friend and peer of Diana within their circle of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) companions. They regularly attend concerts, go on leisurely nature walks together, and share sympathetic conversations about life and romance. They also cooperate on local endeavors, such as participating in the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) and attempting to dissuade neighbors from taking undesirable actions.

- Friend of — friends who attend concerts and share sympathy together  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P32](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0032)</sub>

### [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--diana-barry.md)

Charlotta the Fourth is a friendly acquaintance whom Diana meets while visiting Miss Lavendar [Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). Diana interacts with her during tea parties and later works alongside her while assisting with the preparations for Miss Lavendar's garden wedding.

### [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--fred-wright.md)

[Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) is Diana's romantic partner and secret suitor. After keeping their relationship hidden for a time, Diana becomes engaged to be married to him, confiding the news of her secret romance to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).
